sections.name: Editorial statement
sections.html:
Brand thesis / existing copy

Some chase horsepower. We chase hours.

Fuel & Free Time isn't about how fast you go — it's about finally having the time to go at all. Born in a Lafayette garage, built for those who've earned their freedom. Time is everything money can't buy back.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.html:
What this preview means

Existing, sourced, and concept are kept separate.

What is already real today?+

The F&FT brand copy and collection directions, the Fuel N Free Time Tee, Fresh Till Death hat, Fuel + Adventure tee imagery, archived graphics/video, and the project/gallery media shown here already exist in the current buildout.

What is sourced but not yet a live F&FT product?+

The highlighted drinkware, sunglasses, luggage tag, heavyweight tee, and other add-ons come from the current available Completeful catalog mirror. They still need product creation, artwork, final pricing, shipping validation, and publish steps.

What is a campaign concept?+

Earned Hours, High Octane, Masters, and Project Stories are being arranged here as customer-facing campaign directions using existing F&FT source material. The purpose is to approve the vibe before we scaffold campaign/product records around it.
